narr: Under an easterly wind flow, subtle disturbances in the upper-levels moved across the state, helping to instigate thunderstorm activity across portions of south-central and southwestern Arizona during the late afternoon and early evening hours. The strongest thunderstorm activity was concentrated from western Maricopa County through most of La Paz and Yuma Counties. Strong instability (SB CAPE of 2000+ J/KG) and high moisture content (PWAT 1.8+ inches) resulted in an environment favorable for the development of strong to severe thunderstorms, which led to instances of damaging wind gusts as well as flash flooding.
ev: Stream gauge at Delaney Wash reached above action stage at 1.90 feet at 1859 MST. No damages or injuries were reported.
SR-238 was completely closed between Gila Bend and SR-347 due to flooding. Timing estimated from radar. No damages or injuries were reported.
